sam: Saved the day. +1 for croissants and plant CPR. Should we do a tiny sticker + coffee reward? :medal: :coffee: 
rachel: yes please. vote with emoji so ops-bot knows. :point_down:
sam: :medal: :coffee:decaf
tess: :grin: i accept humble sticker honors
kudos-bot: logged award=tess points=3 reason="demo audio fix + breakroom fern rescue"
rachel: adding to the kudos log now- cheers team. tiny celebration at 3pm near the snack shelf?
